description:
VPN with HTTPS/SSH jump hosts, SOCKS5, MASQUE and split tunneling

VPN client for your HTTPS, SOCKS5, MASQUE α (HTTP/3) or SSH server. Supports HTTPS/SSH jump hosts with separate credentials per hop, split tunneling and DoH.

Profiles, import/export, configuration subscriptions, automatic failover, connection and speed tests, VPN visibility and IP reputation.

No account, ads or analytics. Credentials are encrypted at rest; logs stay local unless shared. Diagnostics contact external services.

Servers are not included. SOCKS5 does not encrypt its connection or credentials. MASQUE is experimental.
